citations.quote: wrapFetchWithPayment clones the caller Request and fetch(request) first, with no payment header.
If status !== 402 return. Else parse body JSON and httpClient.getPaymentRequiredResponse(getHeader, body).
v2: decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. v1: body.x402Version === 1. Else throw Invalid payment required response.
createPaymentPayload selects accepts, requires a registered scheme+network client, then schemeNetworkClient.createPaymentPayload(x402Version, requirements, { extensions }).
selectPaymentRequirements filters by registered network/scheme, extra.paymentFlow, spend controls, then prefers authorization.
v1 amount field is maxAmountRequired; v2 amount field is requirement.amount.
fetchAllDiscoveryResources paginates discoveryUrl with limit/offset and reads data.resources ?? data.items.
discoverX402Services uses resolvedUrl + "/discovery/resources" (Coinbase Bazaar by default).
make_http_request reads payment-required via JSON.parse(atob(...)).accepts, else body.accepts; keeps scheme, network, asset, maxAmountRequired, amount, payTo.
